'''Suz-Anz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] residing on [[Makeb]] with her [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|Apprentice]], [[Lyla]]. The two were outcasts, and both eventually fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. They meditated on Makeb together until [[3638 BBY]], when both were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Suz-Anz appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Makeb. She is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means she was killed.
